name: Semrush
description: Semrush is a digital marketing platform for SEO, content, and competitive research, combining keyword research, site auditing, backlink analysis, and AI visibility tracking to help brands grow and measure visibility across digital channels.
best_for: Positioned for solopreneurs, freelancers, small teams, agencies, mid-market companies, and enterprises across industries like SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, and professional services.
features: Keyword research across a database of billions of keywords
Site audit and technical SEO health analysis
Competitor and backlink analysis with rank tracking across 142 geo databases
AI visibility tracking that monitors brand mentions across LLM prompts
PPC and advertising tools for Google and Meta
Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization

tiers.name: SEO
tiers.notes: Per month, billed annually ($139/mo billed monthly). 5 websites, 500 tracked keywords, Site Audit, basic AI-search visibility tracking.

tiers.name: Starter (SEO + AI Search)
tiers.notes: Per month, billed annually ($199/mo billed monthly). 5 websites, 500 keywords, keyword research/optimization, 50 AI prompts tracked daily.

tiers.name: Pro+ (SEO + AI Search)
tiers.notes: Per month, billed annually ($299/mo billed monthly). 15 websites, 1,500 keywords, historical SEO data, multi-location tracking.

tiers.name: Advanced (SEO + AI Search)
tiers.notes: Per month, billed annually ($549/mo billed monthly). 40 websites, 5,000 keywords, SEO share of voice, API data integration.

alternatives.name: Ahrefs
alternatives.description: An AI-powered SEO and marketing platform built on a proprietary web index, covering keyword research, backlinks, and content marketing.
alternatives.best_for: SEO specialists and content marketers wanting deep backlink and keyword data

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free web analytics platform for tracking website traffic, user behavior, and conversions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing free, foundational traffic and conversion analytics

alternatives.name: Sprout Social
alternatives.description: A social intelligence platform that turns real-time social signals into direction for teams, enabling monitoring, management, and action on social conversations at scale.
alternatives.best_for: Teams prioritizing publishing, engagement, listening, and social analytics over an SEO-centered marketing suite.
